learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to learn different manufacturing techniques to produce products using different materials.
Students will be able to analyze the forces, torques, and power requirements resulting from different machining operations.
Students will be able to select the correct manufacturing system for a given design and production quantity.
Students will be able to understand the effect of material properties on manufacturing systems.
Students will be able to analyze and solve different types of manufacturing system problems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Welding and Welding Processes
bibliography: M. P. Groover, Fundamentals of Modern Manufacturing: Materials, Processes, and Systems, 4th Edition, Wiley, 2010 (Ders kitabı).
